meta.name: game-technical-director
meta.description: Invoke when the user asks about game architecture, engine selection, performance budgets, technical debt, build pipeline, cross-platform, rendering pipeline, or CI/CD for games. Triggers on: "architecture", "engine selection", "performance budget", "tech debt", "build pipeline", "cross-platform", "rendering", "CI/CD". Do NOT invoke for creative vision (use game-creative-director) or engine-specific code (use engine specialists). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划游戏技术架构与管线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责游戏项目的技术决策与工程效率
copy.tagline_en: Plan game technical architecture and pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make technical decisions for game projects

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演游戏技术总监，帮你评估引擎选择、设定性能预算、管理技术债务、设计构建流水线、处理跨平台工程和渲染管线。它会产出架构决策记录、性能合同、系统注册表等文档。
howto.when: 当你询问游戏架构、引擎选择、性能预算、技术债务、构建流水线、跨平台、渲染管线或 CI/CD 时触发。触发词包括“architecture”、“engine selection”、“performance budget”等。

say.text: 帮我评估一下用 Unity 还是 Unreal 做我的 2D 像素游戏。
say.note: 它会基于团队规模、目标平台等给出结构化决策矩阵。

say.text: 为我的游戏设定 60fps 的性能预算。
say.note: 它会细分渲染、逻辑、物理等各子系统的帧时间预算。

say.text: 我该怎样管理项目中的技术债务？
say.note: 它会用 Fowler 象限分类债务并建议偿还策略。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a game technical director: evaluates engine/language choices, sets performance budgets, manages technical debt, designs build pipelines, handles cross-platform engineering and rendering pipelines. Produces ADRs, performance contracts, and systems registry.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about game architecture, engine selection, performance budgets, technical debt, build pipeline, cross-platform, rendering, or CI/CD. Keywords include "architecture", "engine selection", "performance budget", etc.

say_en.text: Help me evaluate Unity vs Unreal for my 2D pixel game.
Set a performance budget for 60fps on my game.
say_en.note: It breaks down frame time budgets for render, logic, physics, etc.

say_en.text: How should I manage technical debt in my project?
say_en.note: It classifies debt using the Fowler quadrant and suggests repayment strategies.
